text:
[Council File 26-1334]
Joint Bureau of Street Services, Bureau of Sanitation, and General Services Department report relative to the implementation strategy for the Fiscal Year 2026-27 Clean Corridors Program.
(This item is referred to the Budget and Finance Committee, Personnel and Hiring Committee, and Public Works Committee.)
Fiscal Impact Statement:
No
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
summary: Council takes up the implementation strategy for the Fiscal Year 2026-27 Clean Corridors Program, a joint effort of Street Services, Sanitation and General Services.

details.bureau: Bureau of Street Services, Bureau of Sanitation

outcome.text: Budget and Finance Committee concurred with the Public Works Committee's action of October 13, 2026 (Oct 20, 2026)
